We met Dani in 2023 when our dog, Caju, started showing very serious separation anxiety problems and literally began eating our entire house.

One of the training methods Dani suggested at that time was getting him used to a carrier. We had never heard of it, but we went ahead, bought the carrier, and Caju adapted very well. The carrier allowed him to have his safe space, whether when fireworks were going off, to sleep, or to chew on his toys; he really liked it and adapted!

Caju's training didn't stop with these basic issues, but continued over the years so that he would behave very well in public and could act as a service animal in some situations.

This training had another very positive effect: from the beginning, we knew that we would move far away someday, and Caju would come with us.

We moved to Spain and the whole trip was very smooth, no problems on the plane (he slept the whole trip and was calm), no problems at the Airbnb, good from beginning to end, no barking, no fear.

Now Caju has a new crate! The same security, the same comfort, thanks to a lot of effort and dedication from everyone, but especially from Dani in guiding him towards a much more peaceful path.

We recommend DGPets to everyone who has similar goals. The sooner they get used to it, the better the adaptation and the better your dog's life will be <3

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Dani practically saved my dog, Luna. She was very anxious and couldn't stay home alone. Neighbors, quite rightly, complained because it was very disruptive. After about two months of work, the progress was impressive: today she is much calmer, more confident, and can stay alone without the crises she used to have. I recommend her for her professionalism, dedication, and the results that truly made a difference in our daily lives.

We met Dani soon after Rambo joined our family. Our first contact was for his training, and since then, she has become our go-to person when it comes to canine care, education, and well-being.

Now we had the opportunity to leave Rambo with her for 15 days, and once again she exceeded all our expectations. Traveling already generates natural concern for those who love their pets, but with Dani we had the peace of mind of knowing that he was being cared for with great affection, responsibility, and professionalism.

Rambo returned extremely happy, calm, and full of energy. You can tell he was very well cared for and received individual attention throughout his stay.

Dani's great differentiator is that her work goes far beyond boarding or doggy daycare. There is a careful approach to each dog, respecting their personality and needs. Furthermore, she develops a program of education, socialization, and behavioral management. It's not simply letting the dogs play together: everything is done with purpose, technique, knowledge, and a lot of love.

Another point that charmed us was the care in every detail. Rambo returned with gifts and was overjoyed to be reunited with his family, which shows how safe and cared for he felt during this period.

Today we recommend Dani without hesitation. She is an extremely competent, ethical, dedicated professional who is passionate about what she does. In a market where it's so difficult to find someone we can fully trust, she is undoubtedly exceptional.

If you are looking for training, doggy daycare, or boarding for your dog and want someone who truly treats each animal as if it were part of their own family, you can be sure you are making the best choice.

She provided excellent consulting services to someone who is getting a puppy for the first time.

Lots of tips.

Dani's work is incredible. Since we started, our dog's behavioral improvement has been clear… the interaction with other dogs, along with all the training, has helped her with her insecurity and fear. Her work is extremely professional, careful, and at the same time, full of affection. She takes care of our dog, but also guides us as owners—we learn a lot about how to act in our daily lives to address existing problems.

You can see how much she loves what she does, and this is reflected in how the dogs respond. Pitu loves Aunt Dani and spending the day with her!! This brings us a lot of security and peace of mind.

We wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking not just for training, but for a complete service!!

We adopted a puppy and were very unsure about how to help her cope well on her own, among other behavioral issues. And it was great to have found Dani, because she spent over two hours on a video call giving us tips and after a few days, she came to help Mirna take her first walk outside. Besides the follow-up via WhatsApp messages, which is also very valuable, since we give her updates on what's happening and she gives us more tips.
In short, I highly recommend DG Pets' services, because from the very first day of guidance, we could already see improvement in Mirna 🤗😊
She is very good at mapping out the dogs' profiles and provides important guidance for correcting behaviors. She is very attentive.

I highly recommend DGPets' work. I adopted a puppy. She's very sweet, but incredibly reactive towards other dogs. I hired a trainer recommended by neighbors in the building, but after 1 year and 6 months of work, she hadn't improved. She learned commands and tricks, but remained very reactive with other dogs. That's when I found a Facebook post from the neighborhood praising DGPets' work, so I decided to contact them to find out more and try something different. It was worth it; it was the best thing I did. Even during the initial assessment, I received many effective instructions, and with just a few training sessions, my dog's reactivity has already improved significantly.

Daniella's work is simply wonderful! The consultation with her was VERY worthwhile; we had immediate results and are building others together, with her support and guidance at every stage (this is very important!).

She has an incredible teaching style, explains everything with great patience, and truly cares about the well-being of the dog and the family. You can see that she loves what she does and has a lot of knowledge.

I recommend her without hesitation! If you're in doubt, you can go without fear!

Daniella helped us reduce Toby's stress and emotional dependence.

Our dog, a Yorkshire Terrier, is elderly, and even so, we saw positive results.

Through techniques, our dog is able to go for walks more calmly, and his possessive behavior at home has changed.

I recommend Daniella.
Dani is very attentive to both us and Dora, our Corgi. The progress with the training is very noticeable. I recommend her.
